criteria.name: Self-directed evidence discovery and citations
criteria.description: Finds relevant files without being given exact names and cites package-relative paths for event reports, physical hazard summaries, exposure/impact data, geospatial or facility context, and remote-sensing constraints.

criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.75 point for each correct mechanism marker.

criteria.name: Short precipitation slice handling

criteria.name: Index and scenario arithmetic

criteria.name: Remote-sensing constraint and interpretation
